event.description: Excise unused PAD row from retained checkpoint without changing digit logits
event.proposal: Family: token representation. Current retained frontier is 3,424 parameters at 99.180000%, a +0.180000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 3 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0005, the interleaved representation at 5,792 parameters and 99.93% official accuracy; the most recent failed result is attempt-0014, an optimization failure where the PAD-free architecture remained near 9% validation under fresh training and received no official score. Hypothesis: PAD is functionally unused and removable, but width-7 fresh optimization is seed-fragile; exact checkpoint surgery that deletes old row 11 and shifts the retained BOS/EOS rows preserves every digit logit, all attention/FF weights, and generic decoding while yielding 3,408 parameters. This parameterization-preserving repair is more informative than the nearest untested fresh-seed retry because it directly separates representational necessity from optimization luck and changes no candidate semantics beyond removing the unreachable PAD class.
